files.summary: SiteDocument defines a simple data structure for documents associated with a Site in the HSPnet system.
files.purpose: Represents documents linked to a site, storing identifiers for both the document and the site.
content_gaps: No workflows, business logic, or usage scenarios described.

files.summary: Welcome page logic for staff/admin users with user preference information, last login display, and filtering/reporting features.
files.purpose: Displays a staff/admin dashboard with filtering by site, discipline, and date ranges. Provides controls for filtering, data refresh, and user session display.

workflows.name: Filter and view submitted employment applications
steps: User selects a site, discipline, and date range using dropdowns and date pickers.
User may toggle show withdrawn applications.
User clicks refresh to reload the results grid.
Data grid is updated via ObjectDataSource based on parameters.
Each row provides navigation to detailed views and email options.

business_rules: Required fields: start and end dates.
End date must be after or equal to start date.
Validation summarized in a message box using ValidationSummary.
validations: Start and end dates must be valid and not empty.
Regular expression validation for date format.
system_behavior: Page shows/hides panels for errors and warnings.
Last Login display is visible if populated in user session.
Dropdown lists are auto-populated and may include an 'All' option.
exceptions: If user session is missing, data selection is canceled.

files.summary: ServiceCode is a domain entity and data access logic for code categories and coding options for courses and timetables.
files.purpose: Manage and retrieve lists of service codes for use in categorizing services, courses, or timetables. Supports multi-language naming.

workflows.name: List all service codes
steps: Call ServiceCodeListAll with session information.
Return all service codes, localized if required.

workflows.name: List service codes for course or timetable
steps: Call ServiceCodeASMOptionByCourseID or ServiceCodeASMOptionByTimetableID with session and relevant ID.
Return matching service codes.

business_rules: If alternate language mode is set in session, use alt language fields for names and notes.
conditions: Language selection logic based on session.
dependencies: Database stored procedures: ServiceCodeListAll, ServiceCodeASMOptionByCourseID, ServiceCodeASMOptionByTimetableID
content_gaps: UI and security handling not described.

files.summary: SiteProfileHistory records changes and historical data for SiteProfiles, including who made changes, when, and in what context.
files.purpose: Audit log for site profile modifications, capturing actions, user/agency information, and field-level change details.

workflows.name: Audit SiteProfile changes
steps: SiteProfileHistory is updated when changes occur to a SiteProfile.
Relevant details including date, user, action, and agency are recorded.
UI component can query and display audit records, handling session and SiteID parameters.

business_rules: Display localized fields if user session is set to alt language fields.
calculations: Formatted display names and details for UI rendering.
conditions: Behavior changes if ByUserSysAdmin is true or user IDs differ.
system_behavior: User control disables querying if user session is not present.
content_gaps: How histories are triggered from UI not detailed.

files.summary: EmailPopupDocument models temporary/ephemeral files for email attachments in the UI. Includes logic for searching and deleting files.
files.purpose: Supports file attachment search and deletion within email popups, with actions on the file system for removals.

workflows.name: Search EmailPopupDocuments
steps: Data string is split by '|', each entry split by '>' to FileName and FilePath.
Each item is assigned a sequential ID and added to results.

workflows.name: Delete EmailPopupDocument
steps: Identify index in the data array.
Delete the file at FilePath and its directory.

business_rules: On delete, if file exists, delete file and parent directory.
system_behavior: Physical file deletion when document is removed.
exceptions: Deletes are wrapped in try/catch blocks; failures do not throw errors.
content_gaps: Does not describe upload logic or UI triggers.

files.summary: ExpenseBatch describes the logic and entity for tracking expense batches by department, with add, update, delete, and search operations.
files.purpose: Used to manage financial batch operations related to department expenses.

workflows.name: Search ExpenseBatches by department
steps: Call search method with DepartmentID, returns list of ExpenseBatch records for recent year.

workflows.name: Add ExpenseBatch
steps: Insert new record with parameters (DepartmentID, BatchDescription, BatchDate), get newly created ID.

workflows.name: Update ExpenseBatch
steps: Update record by ID with new description, date, status.

workflows.name: Delete ExpenseBatch
steps: Delete record by ID.

business_rules: StatusDescription is localized if session indicates alternate language.
conditions: UseAltLanguageFields in session triggers alt language lookup.
dependencies: ExpenseBatchSearch, ExpenseBatchAdd, ExpenseBatchUpdate, ExpenseBatchDelete stored procedures
content_gaps: No UI logic, only data layer present.
